300: // RebalanceServers shuffles the order in which Servers will be contacted. The
301: // function will shuffle the set of potential servers to contact and then attempt
302: // to contact each server. If a server successfully responds it is used, otherwise
303: // it is rotated such that it will be the last attempted server.
304: func (m *Manager) RebalanceServers() {
305: 	// Shuffle servers so we have a chance of picking a new one.
306: 	servers := m.GetServers()
307: 	servers.shuffle()
308: 
309: 	// Iterate through the shuffled server list to find an assumed
310: 	// healthy server.  NOTE: Do not iterate on the list directly because
311: 	// this loop mutates the server list in-place.
312: 	var foundHealthyServer bool
313: 	for i := 0; i < len(m.servers); i++ {
314: 		// Always test the first server.  Failed servers are cycled
315: 		// while Serf detects the node has failed.
316: 		srv := servers[0]
317: 
318: 		err := m.connPoolPinger.Ping(srv.Addr)
319: 		if err == nil {
320: 			foundHealthyServer = true
321: 			break
322: 		}
323: 		m.logger.Debug("error pinging server", "error", err, "server", srv)
324: 
325: 		servers.cycle()
326: 	}
327: 
328: 	if !foundHealthyServer {
329: 		m.logger.Debug("no healthy servers during rebalance")
330: 		return
331: 	}
332: 
333: 	// Save the servers
334: 	m.Lock()
335: 	m.servers = servers
336: 	m.Unlock()
337: }

339: // refreshServerRebalanceTimer is only called once m.rebalanceTimer expires.
340: func (m *Manager) refreshServerRebalanceTimer() time.Duration {
341: 	m.Lock()
342: 	defer m.Unlock()
343: 	numServers := len(m.servers)
344: 
345: 	// Limit this connection's life based on the size (and health) of the
346: 	// cluster.  Never rebalance a connection more frequently than
347: 	// connReuseLowWatermarkDuration, and make sure we never exceed
348: 	// clusterWideRebalanceConnsPerSec operations/s across numLANMembers.
349: 	clusterWideRebalanceConnsPerSec := float64(numServers * newRebalanceConnsPerSecPerServer)
350: 
351: 	connRebalanceTimeout := helper.RateScaledInterval(clusterWideRebalanceConnsPerSec, clientRPCMinReuseDuration, int(m.numNodes))
352: 	connRebalanceTimeout += helper.RandomStagger(connRebalanceTimeout)
353: 
354: 	m.rebalanceTimer.Reset(connRebalanceTimeout)
355: 	return connRebalanceTimeout
356: }

361: 	m.Lock()
362: 	defer m.Unlock()
